outcome: Proportion of borderline resectable and locally advanced tumours resected
cohort: Patients undergoing extended pancreatic resections, as defined by the International Study Group for Pancreatic Surgery, at a single institute between 2007 and 2022 were included.
finding: Increasingly complex pancreatic resections performed in the later period (2015-2022) showed consistent perioperative outcomes and improved disease-free survival for resectable, node-positive tumours compared to the earlier period (2007-2015).
